title: Learning to Segment from Noisy Annotations: A Spatial Correction Approach
mechanism: A Markov model treats label noise as spatially correlated and biased, so boundaries grow or shrink as a chain, and boundary pixels are corrected progressively with theoretical guarantees.
adaptation: Fit the noise bias per source: dilation for BMRK and SDLE (3 px), jitter for ARTS, CFVS and CSIR. Correct only the crack and inactive boundary band. The same Markov noise model can also generate controlled label-noise copies for a benchmark stress track.
min_experiment: Arm: house + spatial correction on crack and inactive bands, 5 seeds. Baseline: house, 5 seeds. Metrics: crack IoU, inactive IoU, per-source crack IoU (BMRK). Kill if neither crack IoU nor inactive IoU shows a detectable difference.
evidence: R (abstract): beats state-of-the-art methods on synthetic and real noisy annotations. Per the repo README, it was evaluated on JSRT among others. Blobby organs, not thin structures.

alt_notes.adaptation: Fit the noise model on our real pairs: 265 cells with both 2021 and 2022 crack labels, plus ridge-snapped labels as a third version. Correct crack labels once after the early-learning point of a house run (val crack AP plateau, about 4k to 6k steps), retrain from scratch. Extend to gridline (recall 0.33) and material.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house -> correct at early-learning point -> retrain, 5 seeds; baseline: house. Metrics: crack IoU, relF1@2, gridline IoU. Kill if crack IoU and relF1@2 both n.d. (< 0.012) and gridline gain < 0.03.

alt_notes.adaptation: No clean set exists: estimate the offset per source relative to ridge-snapped val labels or a reference source. Use it to correct train labels per source and as a per-source inference-time width offset to match each source's label convention on test.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: per-source signed-distance offset applied to house model crack logits at inference (no retraining), then a retrain on SC-corrected labels. Baseline: house 5-seed. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU and per-source crack IoU. Kill: inference-only arm under +0.008 crack IoU and retrain arm under +0.012.

alt_notes.adaptation: Apply only to crack (and possibly gridline) labels. Treat the 1-2 px trace jitter and source width as spatial noise and correct toward the dark ridge; leave the structural classes untouched.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm = house PF trained with spatially corrected crack labels (5 seeds) versus house PF. Metrics: crack IoU clean-49 and relF1@2. Kill if crack IoU gain < +0.012.
